provenance.notes: Hard-tier trypsin-classics pair (08-PROPOSALS.md Set 4, APPROVED 2026-09-26): benzamidine CID 2332 (neutral free base as-registered per C3; the charged benzamidinium chloride CID 444655 alternate NOT substituted - plan's default row followed) + guanidinium CID 32838 (+1, 3D status resolved VERIFIED during 08-04 per C4; no alternate needed). Per-record citation per U1: 'PubChem Identifier: CID <CID>; URL: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/<CID>'. Complex reference metadata: CC0 1.0 (wwPDB).

Benzamidine, PubChem CID 2332 (C7H8N2, 9 heavy, Charge 0 as recorded per approved C3 - the research's '+1 amidinium' claim is INCORRECT for this CID; the charged benzamidinium chloride CID 444655 alternate is approved but NOT substituted). Complex: 1S0R bovine trypsin-benzamidine, atomic resolution - THE classic serine-protease system (BEN confirmed in nonpolymer inventory; CA ion also present, second cleanup-analog datapoint, verified 2026-09-26); primary paper DOI NONE recorded in the RCSB data (honest absence; title verified 'Bovine Pancreatic Trypsin inhibited with Benzamidine at Atomic resolution'). Carries h_bond (amidine N-H donors + ring-N acceptors), pi_stacking (benzene), hydrophobic, cation_pi in the AA-cation-over-lig-ring direction only (ligand neutral).

Guanidinium, PubChem CID 32838 (CH6N3+, 4 heavy, Charge +1 as recorded; 3D record VERIFIED during 08-04 approval re-verification per C4 - research's '3D unverified' resolved). Complex: 5NWQ Thermobifida fusca guanidine III riboswitch + guanidine (GAI confirmed in inventory, chemcomp GAI = GUANIDINE - note CCD GUN = GUANINE, recorded pitfall, verified 2026-09-26). The +1 C(N)3 charged group makes this the set's salt_bridge carrier AND the ligand-side cation_pi showcase; per the 02-06 recorded detector law the ligand guanidino center is the centroid of the 3 bonded Ns (the gate's 'midpoint of 2 Ns' is the protein-side Arg pattern; isolated guanidinium has 3 equivalent Ns) - this ligand exercises that real-world geometry. Ammonium-veto boundary: the PLIP veto targets ammonium N with exactly 3 non-H substituents; guanidinium's C-centered cation sits on the boundary, a live boundary-case demo. Also h_bond donors (6 N-H). The cation (+1) chosen deliberately: salt-bridge + ligand-cation carrier.
